note: Rules seeded from REAL committed electrical line vocabulary (work_header='Electrical', is_current=1, node_type='Line Item'; n=4282) mined 2026-06-29. Token counts in each `source` are live-corpus document frequencies. Weights are provisional and tunable via scoring.json semantics; recalibrate against team verdicts + AI agreement. match against: item_keyword/exclusion -> description+notes; ancestor -> the parent_node ancestor chain. Build 2b: POINT WIRING FULL PRECEDENCE -- a point-frame (light/fan/plug/power point, points controlled, controlled by mcb/switch, mcb-to-first-light) zeroes conduit_piping / switches_sockets / wiring_cabling via point-frame exclusion rules so the bundled point line reads point_wiring even when it names conduit/switch/cable. DB-TO-FIRST-POINT SEAM: a bare 'DB to first point' sized feeder with NO named load is suppressed (WC-EXCL-DBFIRSTPOINT) and 'first point' is deliberately NOT a point_wiring positive token, so it lands blank/review, not a confident label. TERMINATION MERGED into wiring_cabling (TERM-* re-pointed). NETWORKING removed (NW-DATA deleted); data vocab is suppressed from wiring_cabling (WC-EXCL-NETWORKING) so cat6/rj45/patch-panel lines route to blank (cross-discipline).

rules.plain: Names a wiring point (light/fan/call-bell/plug) - the per-point circuit run from the switch or distribution board to the outlet.
rules.source: corpus: light point 177

rules.plain: Describes points grouped under a control device (e.g. 'controlled by MCB' = small circuit breaker), the hallmark of point-wiring lots.
rules.source: corpus: controlled by 323, points 182

rules.plain: Sits under a Point Wiring section header.
rules.source: corpus preamble: 'Point Wiring', 'LIGHT POINTS DIRECTLY CONTROLLED BY SWITCH/MCB'

rules.plain: A 'wiring for ... point(s)' lot (e.g. 'Wiring for fan points with 3x2.5 sq mm'): this is point wiring - the cable size quoted is just the wire used for the point, not a cable-run item.
rules.source: FIX3 proving-run 2026-06-30: 31 'Wiring for X points' lines mis-scored wiring_cabling

rules.plain: An 'MCB -> first light / low-power device' point run: a named load (first LIGHT) makes this point wiring. NOTE: a bare 'first point' with no named load is deliberately NOT matched here - that is the DB-to-first-point review seam (see WC-EXCL-DBFIRSTPOINT).
rules.source: Build 2b owner ruling: MCB->first light = point_wiring; bare DB->first point (no load) = review.

rules.plain: Specifies a conductor cross-section (sq mm) and core count - cable is being run as a length.
rules.source: corpus: sq.mm 745, core 551

rules.plain: Names a cable / conductor.
rules.source: corpus: cable 649, copper 497

rules.plain: Cable insulation/armour spec: XLPE (heat-resistant insulation), FRLS (flame-retardant low-smoke), armoured (steel-wire-armoured) - identifies a power cable.
rules.source: corpus: frls 413, armoured 329, xlpe 289

rules.plain: Sits under an LT / EB Cables section header.
rules.source: corpus preamble: 'LT CABLES', 'EB CABLES'

rules.plain: FIX3 guard: a 'wiring for ... point(s)' line is point wiring, not a cable-run item, so the wiring_cabling signal from its quoted cable size is suppressed.
rules.source: FIX3 proving-run 2026-06-30: wiring_cabling over-fired on point-wiring lots

rules.plain: Build 2b Point Wiring precedence: when a point-frame (a named point / controlled-by / mcb-to-first-light) is present, the cable size quoted is just the wire used for the point - suppress the wiring_cabling read so point_wiring wins.
rules.source: Build 2b owner ruling: point-frame overrides component words.

rules.plain: Build 2b DB-to-first-point seam: a bare 'DB to first point' sized feeder with NO named load must NOT read a confident wiring_cabling - suppress it so the line lands blank -> human review (the load is unknown; do not force a label).
rules.source: Build 2b owner ruling: bare DB->first point (no load) = review, not a confident category.

rules.plain: Build 2b networking removal: structured-data vocab (CAT6/RJ45/patch panel/UTP) is cross-discipline (Data & Networking), NOT power wiring_cabling - suppress the generic 'cable' read so these lines route to blank/review instead of being mislabelled power cabling.
rules.source: Build 2b / Design doc §20.3: networking excluded -> blank.

rules.plain: Names a modular wiring accessory (switch/socket/face-plate/regulator).
rules.source: corpus: socket 338, switch 314, modular 90

rules.plain: Mentions a switch or socket outlet.
rules.source: corpus: socket 338, switch 314, round 210

rules.plain: Sits under a Socket Outlets / Power Receptacles section header.
rules.source: corpus preamble: 'SOCKET OUTLETS', 'POWER RECEPTACLES'

rules.plain: Build 2b Point Wiring precedence: a point-frame line ('point controlled by switch') is point wiring, not a loose switch/socket accessory - suppress the switches_sockets read.
rules.source: Build 2b owner ruling: point-frame overrides component words.

rules.plain: A distribution-board schedule (way-count, incomer/outgoing breaker list) - a standalone DB, not a built panel.
rules.source: corpus: outgoing 175, way 130, incomer 111, mcb db 99

rules.plain: Quotes a DB way-count / pole configuration (TPN/SPN = triple/single-pole-and-neutral).
rules.source: corpus: 'N way' 130, TPN/SPN 125

rules.plain: Quotes a breaker trip class ('C'/'D' curve) or earth-leakage sensitivity (mA) - distribution-board detail.
rules.source: corpus: curve 177, mA 108

rules.plain: Names a loose protective device - MCB (small circuit breaker), MCCB (larger breaker), RCCB (earth-leakage breaker) or isolator. On its own this is standalone switchgear, but it could be a component inside a panel assembly - review.
rules.source: corpus: mcb 587, rccb 100, mccb 82, isolator 80

rules.plain: Sits under a Distribution Boards section header.
rules.source: corpus preamble: 'DISTRIBUTION BOARDS - MCB DB, MCB,RCCB'

rules.plain: A UPS (uninterruptible power supply) unit.
rules.source: corpus: ups 258

rules.plain: UPS battery / backup capacity (KVA = electrical capacity rating).
rules.source: corpus: battery 109, kva 89

rules.plain: Sits under a UPS System section header.
rules.source: corpus preamble: 'UPS SYSTEM', 'UPS & BATTERY SYSTEM'

rules.plain: A conduit / raceway pipe that carries wiring (PVC = plastic, MS = mild-steel, GI = galvanised-iron).
rules.source: corpus: conduit 260

rules.plain: Sits under a Conduit / Conduiting section header.
rules.source: corpus preamble: 'Supply and laying of PVC conduit'

rules.plain: Build 2b Point Wiring precedence: a point-frame line that also names conduit ('light points ... with 25mm conduit') is point wiring as a unit - the conduit is part of the point run - so suppress the conduit_piping read.
rules.source: Build 2b owner ruling: point-frame overrides component words.

rules.plain: A heavy-duty industrial socket/plug (often IP-rated, with an integral MCB).
rules.source: corpus: industrial socket 25, plug top 50, metal clad 14

rules.plain: Sits under an Industrial Sockets section header.
rules.source: corpus preamble: 'Industrial Sockets - IP67', 'Metal clad socket outlets'

rules.plain: Cable support / containment: cable tray, ladder, raceway or trunking.
rules.source: corpus: cable tray 178, raceway 99, perforated 40. Build 2a reversed FIX1: junction/pull/draw box vocabulary moved OUT to its own junction_box_raceway category (JB-BOX).

rules.plain: Sits under a Cable Tray / Raceway section header.
rules.source: corpus preamble: 'Hot Dip-galvanised Ladder Type trays', 'Perforated type cable tray'

rules.plain: A junction / pull / draw box for the raceway / cable system - its own priced category (a box, not the tray/raceway run itself).
rules.source: Build 2a: reversal of FIX1 - junction/pull/draw box vocabulary moved here out of cabletray_raceway (CT-TRAY). corpus: 49 junction/box fragments.

rules.plain: A pop-up / floor socket box (flip-flop / table / floor outlet unit) - a socket enclosure sunk into a floor or desk.
rules.source: Build 2a: new category seed. corpus preamble: 'POP-UP BOXES', 'FLOOR OUTLET'.

rules.plain: A lighting management / control system: DALI, occupancy/daylight sensors, lighting processor or scene controller.
rules.source: Build 2a: new category seed. corpus: DALI / lighting control / occupancy sensor lines.

rules.plain: A luminaire / light fixture: LED light, LED panel, panel light, downlighter, batten, cove / street / flood / decorative light. A LIGHT POINT (the wiring circuit) is point_wiring, not a fixture.
rules.source: Build 2a: new category seed. corpus: luminaire / down light / panel light lines. Build 2b: added 'led panel' so a '2X2 LED panel' reads light_fixtures (panels PNL-ASSEMBLY already excludes led/panel light/luminaire, so it never reads panels).

rules.plain: A genuine electrical miscellaneous item (fixing accessory, GI frame, RCC cutting / chasing for electrical work). POSITIVE placement only - deliberately LOW weight and few tokens so it never becomes an uncertainty catch-all (blank remains the uncertainty outcome).
rules.source: Build 2a: new category seed, CONSERVATIVE. Kept minimal on purpose per Rebuild Spec v2.0 - miscellaneous is a positive read, NOT a fallback.

rules.plain: Cable end-work: terminations, lugs, glands or jointing. Build 2b merged the former 'termination' category into 'Wiring, Cabling & Termination' (wiring_cabling).
rules.source: corpus: termination 459, endterminations 315, gland 57. Build 2b: re-pointed from termination -> wiring_cabling (merge).

rules.plain: Sits under an end-termination section header (part of Wiring, Cabling & Termination after the Build 2b merge).
rules.source: corpus preamble: 'Supplying and making of end termination', 'terminal joints'. Build 2b: re-pointed from termination -> wiring_cabling (merge).

rules.plain: Part of the earthing system: earth strip, pit, electrode or GI (galvanised-iron) strip. (Excluded when the line is really a socket that merely mentions an earth pin.)
rules.source: corpus: earthing 322, earth strip 40, gi strip 39

rules.plain: Sits under an Earthing section header.
rules.source: corpus preamble: 'EARTH STRIPS', 'EARTHING'

rules.plain: Names a built panel / switch-board assembly (a fabricated enclosure that houses breakers as one unit).
rules.source: corpus: panel 128, lt panel 27

rules.plain: Panel fabrication/assembly language: bus bar, CRCA (cold-rolled steel body), floor-mounted, fabricated, feeder - marks a built panel assembly.
rules.source: corpus: bus bar 42, crca 30, feeder 7

rules.plain: A named panel type: MCC (motor-control), PCC (power-control), APFC (power-factor), or DG/AMF (diesel-generator / auto-mains-failure) panel.
rules.source: corpus: pcc 4, dg/amf 14 (mcc/apfc absent in current corpus - kept for coverage)

rules.plain: Sits under an LT Panel / LT Switch Boards section header.
rules.source: corpus preamble: 'PART - F : LT PANEL', 'LT SWITCH BOARDS'
